resources.description: List of DRBD resources to configure. Each resource defines replicated storage between two or more nodes.

name.description: Name of the DRBD resource (e.g., 'r0', 'data'). Must be unique across all resources.

protocol.description: DRBD protocol to use: 'A' (asynchronous), 'B' (semi-synchronous), or 'C' (synchronous, default).

syncer_rate.description: Maximum synchronization rate for resync operations (e.g., '10M' = 10 MiB/s). Accepts suffixes: K, M, G.

meta_disk.description: Where to store metadata: 'internal' (default, stored in the same disk), or a disk device/path (e.g., 'device /dev/sda2').

device.description: Block device path exposed to the OS (e.g., /dev/drbd0). Must match on all nodes.

disk.description: Underlying physical disk or partition to use (e.g., /dev/sdb1) — leave empty if overridden per host.

on_no_quorum.description: Action when quorum is lost (e.g., 'freeze', 'panic', 'io-error'). Optional.

on_suspendsync_fail.description: Action when suspended synchronization fails (e.g., 'io-error', 'panic'). Optional.

hosts.description: List of host nodes participating in this resource (typically 2 for HA).

hostname.description: Hostname or FQDN of the node (must match output of 'uname -n' or DNS).

node_id.description: Numeric ID for node identification in the cluster (0, 1, ...). Required when >2 nodes.

address.description: IP address and optional port for inter-node communication (e.g., '10.0.0.1:7789').

disk_path.description: Local block device path for this node (e.g., /dev/sdb1) — overrides resource-level disk setting.

meta_disk_path.description: Path for metadata storage on this node (e.g., 'device /dev/sda3' or 'internal').
